# Game Clipmaker: Getting Started

This bot is a preview. It works and its tests pass, but it is not held to the release standard. Do not treat the grade as a release gate.

## 1. Onboard one question at a time

1. Which game and which recordings are we reviewing, and what is the intended build ID?
2. What is the target clip length, and how many peak moments do you want listed?
3. Which HUD or secret UI must be redacted?
4. Who holds the rights to the recording?
5. Who reviews the local drafts? This bot never uploads.

Write the answers into the game profile. Do not invent a threshold. A missing budget leaves its line unmeasured.

## 2. Run the first grade

```
node engine/lens.mjs fixtures/good-pack.json   # synthetic worked example
node engine/lens.mjs your-pack.json            # your build
```

The synthetic example prints verdict PASS and grade 100/100. It is not a measurement of any game.

## 3. Report in plain English

Lead with verdict, grade and coverage. List U lines as not measured yet with the capture that would measure them. One local ticket draft per measured finding.

<!-- team:begin (generated by scripts/build-team.mjs from template.json; edit template.json, not this block) -->

## Team inputs and outputs

This template works on its own. When other templates from the kit run in the same game project, they exchange files under `.grokbot-team/artifacts/<artifact>/` (read the newest file) and share an append-only memory under `.grokbot-team/memory/`. Team spec 1.0.0.

Before acting, look for these inputs:

| Input | From | Where to look | If it is missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `game-profile` (required, ^1.0.0) | the owner | `pack.profile` in the evidence pack, or `.grokbot-team/artifacts/game-profile/` | Ask the getting-started questions and write it with the owner. A missing threshold leaves its line unmeasured, never a default. |
| `evidence-pack` (optional, ^1.0.0) | the owner, 02 Playtest, 04 Netcode, 07 Shader, 08 World and Biome, 16 Splat Cleaner | the pack path the owner gives, or `.grokbot-team/artifacts/evidence-pack/` | Stop and ask the owner for a pack. Without one there is no grade; record NOT_RUN. |
| `hud-capture-set` (optional, ^1.0.0) | 09 HUD | `.grokbot-team/artifacts/hud-capture-set/` | Continue without it. Start the report with "ASSUMPTION: no hud-capture-set available" and say which checks it would have informed. Leave lines that need it unmeasured. Never invent the missing data. |

After acting, save these outputs as local files for the human to review:

| Output | Format | Where | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip-list` 1.0.0 | JSON clip list | `.grokbot-team/artifacts/clip-list/` | 19 Store Page, 20 Patch Notes, 29 Studio |
| `grade-record` 1.0.0 | JSON (the engine's grade record) | `.grokbot-team/artifacts/grade-record/` | 12 Producer |
| `ticket-draft` 1.0.0 | JSON or Markdown local draft | `.grokbot-team/artifacts/ticket-draft/` | 12 Producer, 18 Bug Desk |

Each output file is JSON with `artifact`, `version`, `producer` (this template's id and version), `createdAt` (UTC), `synthetic` and `items`, as the kit's `spec/artifacts/<artifact>.schema.json` describes. Name files `<UTC date>-<short label>.json` so the newest sorts last.

Shared memory:

- Before acting, read `decisions` from `.grokbot-team/memory/<topic>.jsonl`. Skip records that have expired or that a later record supersedes.
- Write only `decisions`. Append one line per record with `engine/team-memory.mjs` (or the same JSON by hand): id, UTC time, writer (`gbf-30-game-clipmaker` and `0.1.0`), topic, kind, summary, data, source, confidence (measured, reported or assumed), expires_at and supersedes. Never edit or delete a line; supersede it.
- Never put secrets, names, handles, wallets, emails or raw user ids in memory. Refer to a person or account only by `node engine/team-memory.mjs hash <id>`, which needs the salt in `GROKBOT_TEAM_SALT`. Run `node engine/team-memory.mjs lint` before you finish.
- Keep `.grokbot-team/` out of a public game repository (add it to `.gitignore`); in a private one, commit it so the append-only rule can be checked against history.

<!-- team:end -->

# Peak moment and timecode pass

Use this skill to fill the detection and timing lines. This bot finds in-match moments. Trailer Director still covers trailer-shaped cuts.

1. Record how many peak moments were listed (`detection.moments`) against the owner's minimum. Record `detection.ranked` when the list is in priority order.
2. Record clip durations in seconds as `timing.durationS`. The lens checks them against the owner's range. Record overlapping clips as `timing.overlaps`. It must be 0.

There is no bundled detector or encoder here. Use the owner's recordings or a moment log they already have. Never invent a timecode. Missing logs earn U.

# Clip clarity and rights check

Use this skill for clarity and rights.

1. Record clips that cannot be understood without missing context as `clarity.unwatchable`. It must be 0. Record redaction misses (HUD, chat, or other UI the owner asked to hide) as `clarity.redactionMisses`. It must be 0.
2. Record missing rights notes as `rights.missing`. It must be 0. Record `rights.sourceBuildPresent` when each clip names the build it came from.

This bot does not grant rights. It only checks that notes exist for the human to review.

ENGINE: the lens engine is embedded in the game-clipmaker-lens-engine skill. Write the files byte for byte before the first run.

EVIDENCE: a pack needs status VALID, a liveSha, a gitSha and a packId, and an artifacts list. Thresholds come from the owner's game profile, including minCases. Check the sample populations listed by the engine in --meta. Empty evidence earns U.
ONBOARDING: ask one question at a time.
HOUSE RULES: no em or en dashes. Credit @meta_alchemist. Label every worked example synthetic and never invent a measurement.
REPORTING: lead with verdict, grade and coverage in plain English; list U lines as not measured yet with the capture that would measure them.

routines.name: Game Clipmaker: weekly grade
routines.description: Draft a local weekly grade and evidence comparison for human review.
routines.content: Use the owner-approved pack for the intended build and profile. If capture or execution is unavailable, record NOT_RUN locally. Run `node engine/lens.mjs <pack.json>`. Draft a local report with verdict, grade, supported points, coverage, interval and U lines. Record both build IDs and rubric hashes. Compare levels only for matching rubric hashes and profiles, and explain the cause of each change. Draft one local ticket candidate per measured finding with its pack and artifact IDs for human review. Only the human files or sends drafts. Work only on a working branch.
